subject: ODP
body: On a drilling rig, which machine raises and lowers the drill string?
explanation: It winds the drilling line over the crown and travelling blocks.

subject: ODP
body: What is the main job of drill collars?
options: To carry mud to the surface
To put weight on the bit
explanation: They are heavy, thick-walled pipes above the bit.

subject: ODP
body: Which equipment removes rock cuttings from returning mud?
explanation: Vibrating screens separate cuttings from mud.

subject: ODP
body: A 'kick' is
options: the first turn of the drill bit
an unplanned influx of formation fluid into the wellbore
explanation: If not controlled, a kick can become a blowout.

subject: ODP
body: Which is a common warning sign of a kick?
options: An increase in mud pit volume
A drop in pit volume while pumping normally
explanation: Flow with pumps off is another key sign.

subject: ODP
body: Which casing string is set first and shallowest?
explanation: Then surface, intermediate and production casing.

subject: ODP
body: What is the main purpose of cementing casing?
options: To bond the casing in place and isolate zones from each other
explanation: Good cement prevents fluids migrating between formations.

subject: ODP
body: What is perforating?
options: Shooting holes through casing and cement so reservoir fluids can enter the well

subject: ODP
body: Which artificial lift method uses an electric pump downhole?
explanation: Gas lift injects gas to lighten the fluid column.

subject: ODP
body: A three-phase separator separates
explanation: Two-phase separators separate liquid and gas.

subject: ODP
body: Which chemical is commonly used to remove water from natural gas?
explanation: Amine units remove H₂S and CO₂ (sweetening).

subject: ODP
body: What is cavitation in a centrifugal pump?
options: Vapour bubbles forming and collapsing because suction pressure is too low

subject: ODP
body: Pigging a pipeline is done to
options: clean it or inspect it internally

subject: ODP
body: Porosity is
options: the fraction of rock volume that is pore space
how easily fluid flows through rock
explanation: Permeability measures how easily fluid flows.

subject: ODP
body: An anticline is a type of
explanation: Oil and gas collect at the crest under a seal.

subject: ODP
body: Water injection in a field is mainly used to
options: maintain reservoir pressure and push oil towards producing wells
explanation: It is a common secondary recovery method.
